[project]
name = "spark-workflow-monorepo"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "SPARK Workflow Monorepo"
requires-python = ">=3.13, <3.14"

[tool.uv]
managed = true

[tool.uv.workspace]
members = [
    "02-backend/administrative_file_draft",
    "02-backend/agent_orchestration_service",
    "02-backend/comment_service",
    "02-backend/examination_service",
    "02-backend/document_management_service",
    "02-backend/feedback_service",
    "02-backend/formal_completeness_check",
    "02-backend/fpp_service",
    "02-backend/logging",
    "02-backend/objections_management_service",
    "02-backend/plausibility_notes",
    "02-backend/project_logic_service",
    "02-backend/protocol_service",
    "02-backend/identity_management_service",
    "02-backend/supplementary_requests_service",
    "02-backend/temporal_codec_service",
    "02-backend/temporal_job_service",
    "04-shared-services/authentification",
    "04-shared-services/basiskomponenten/rechtsaenderungs-monitoring",
    "04-shared-services/db-services/gesetze-normen-db-service",
    "04-shared-services/db-services/gesetzesbegruendung-db-service",
    "04-shared-services/db-services/jura-db-service",
    "04-shared-services/db-services/shared",
    "04-shared-services/alembic-utils",
    "04-shared-services/audit-client",
    "04-shared-services/node-crud",
    "04-shared-services/prompt-injection",
    "04-shared-services/temporal",
    "04-shared-services/llm/llm-client",
    "05-modulcluster/modul-anonymisierung",
    "05-modulcluster/modul-einwendungsmanagement",
    "05-modulcluster/modul-formale-pruefung",
    "05-modulcluster/modul-plausibilitaet-pruefung",
    "05-modulcluster/modul-rechtsmethodik",
    "05-modulcluster/modul-bewertung",
    "05-modulcluster/modul-risikohinweiser",
    "05-modulcluster/modul-suche-und-zuordnung",
    "05-modulcluster/modul-inhaltsextraktion",
]


[dependency-groups]
dev = ["ruff>=0.14.6,<0.15", "pyrefly>=0.49.0", "watchfiles>=1.1.1", "poethepoet>=0.37.0"]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 120
# Migrations are auto-generated by Alembic and applied to live databases; they
# are excluded from lint/format rather than hand-edited to satisfy the linter.
extend-exclude = ["__pycache__", "**/src/db/migrations"]

[tool.ruff.lint]
fixable = ["ALL"]

extend-select = [
  # pyupgrade
  "UP",
  # Isort
  "I",
  # Maccabe
  "C901",
  # Eradicate
  "ERA",
  # flake8-bugbear
  "B",
  # pep8-naming
  "N",
  # flake8-builtins
  "A",
  # flake8-comprehensions
  "C4",
  # flake8-debugger
  "T10",
  # pylint
  "PL",
  # ruff-specific rules and best practices
  "RUF",
  # flake8-simplify
  "SIM",
  # flake8-return
  "RET",
  # pyflakes: Checks for logical errors
  'F',
]

ignore = [
  # FastApi recommends to use `Depend()` as an argument default.
  "B008",
  # `input` is the standard Temporal workflow/activity parameter name
  "A002",
  # APIs are forcing camelCase (removed when we have generated api clients)
  "N815",
  # TypeAlias syntax preferred over PEP 695 `type` keyword for Pydantic compatibility
  "UP040",
]

[tool.ruff.lint.isort]
known-first-party = ["src"]

[tool.ruff.lint.mccabe]
# Maximum cyclomatic complexity per function
# Lower = simpler functions
max-complexity = 15

[tool.ruff.lint.pylint]
# Maximum number of function arguments
# Encourages grouping related parameters into objects
max-args = 10

# Maximum number of local variables in a function
# Helps prevent large, difficult-to-follow functions
max-locals = 15

# Maximum number of branches (if/elif/for/while/try)
# Encourages splitting complex logic into smaller functions
max-branches = 12

# Maximum number of return statements
# Too many returns often indicate complicated control flow
max-returns = 6

# Maximum number of statements in a function
max-statements = 50

[tool.poe.tasks.pyrefly-all]
help = "Run pyrefly check in each uv workspace member"
cmd = "bash scripts/pyrefly_all.sh"

[tool.poe.tasks.test]
help = "Run all workspace member pytests. Use --pr to only run it for members you changed"
cmd = "bash scripts/run_all_tests.sh"

[tool.poe.tasks.create-secrets]
help = "Create a private .env file with shared local secrets"
cmd = "bash scripts/create_secrets.sh"

[tool.poe.tasks.process-compose]
help = "Start the native local service stack"
cmd = "process-compose up"
